beats.care: Bus via Ramoshi Gate? It now goes via Golibar Maidan and Swargate. Park on the riverbed road instead.
beats.what: Mahatma Phule Road near Bhavani Mata temple is closed both ways, and entry to Tambdi Jogeshwari Road from Laxmi Road is blocked.
beats.why: Navratri brings big crowds to old-city temples, so police keep roads clear for devotees and safety.

cards.body: Appa Balwant Chowk–Budhwar Chowk is now one-way, only from Budhwar Chowk. Parking is on the riverbed road between Tilak and Bhide bridges, Mandai and Nehru Road.
Measures run Oct 11 to Oct 20, says Pune City Traffic Police.
cards.caption: diversions end

cards.q: How are you doing Navratri this year?

opts: They switch on when queues build up
cards.q: Why are diversions near Chatushrungi only used sometimes?
cards.why: Police divert traffic there only when crowds cause long queues.

hook: Heading out for *Navratri* darshan? These Pune roads are shut
